test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) 2025 evaluates countries based on their performance in:

options.text: GHG Emissions, Renewable Energy, Energy Use, Climate Policy
Carbon Sequestration, Water Conservation, Biodiversity, Pollution Control
Disaster Preparedness, Adaptation Strategies, Mitigation Funding, Policy Implementation
Green Buildings, Sustainable Transport, Waste Management, Circular Economy

solution:
The correct answer is __**GHG Emissions, Renewable Energy, Energy Use, Climate Policy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI)** is an annual publication that evaluates and compares the climate protection performance of 60 countries and the European Union, collectively responsible for over 90% of global greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• The CCPI focuses on four major parameters: **GHG Emissions, Renewable Energy, Energy Use, and Climate Policy**, providing a comprehensive overview of how nations are addressing climate change.
 
• **GHG Emissions:** This category assesses the total greenhouse gas emissions of a country, including emissions from fossil fuel combustion and industrial processes. It is a critical factor in evaluating climate mitigation efforts.
 
• **Renewable Energy:** The index evaluates the share of renewable energy in a country's energy mix and the progress made toward transitioning to sustainable energy sources.
 
• **Energy Use:** This parameter measures the energy consumption of a country per capita and its efficiency in utilizing energy resources to minimize environmental impact.
 
• **Climate Policy:** The index reviews the effectiveness of national and international policies implemented by governments to combat climate change, including commitments made under international frameworks like the Paris Agreement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI):**

 
 
• The CCPI has been published annually by Germanwatch, the NewClimate Institute, and the Climate Action Network (CAN) since **2005**.
 
• The index serves as a tool to enhance transparency in international climate politics and encourages countries to step up their climate protection efforts.
 
• Countries are scored on a scale from 0 (poor performance) to 100 (excellent performance) based on their contributions to global climate mitigation.
 
 
 
• **Paris Agreement:**
 
 
• The Paris Agreement, adopted in **2015**, is a landmark international treaty that aims to limit global warming to below **2°C** above pre-industrial levels.
 
• It encourages countries to submit Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) outlining their climate action plans.
 
 
 
• **Renewable Energy:**
 
 
• Renewable energy sources include solar, wind, hydroelectric, geothermal, and biomass energy, which are crucial for reducing reliance on fossil fuels.
 
• Countries like **Germany** and **Sweden** are leading in renewable energy adoption, serving as examples for others.
 
 
 
• **Global Greenhouse Gas Emissions:**
 
 
• Major contributors to global GHG emissions include energy production, transportation, agriculture, and industrial activities.
 
• Countries like **China**, **India**, and the **United States** are among the top emitters, making their climate policies crucial for global efforts.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **CCPI Scoring:**

 
 
• Each country is assigned a score based on its performance in the four categories, with rankings ranging from **high performers** to **low performers**.
 
• The rankings aim to highlight leaders and laggards in climate action, pushing governments to adopt better policies.
 
 
 
• **Role of Policies:**
 
 
• Effective climate policies are essential for achieving the goals set under international agreements like the Paris Agreement.
 
• Countries with strong policies often invest in renewable energy, energy efficiency, and carbon pricing mechanisms.
 
 
 
• **Significance of CCPI:**
 
 
• The index serves as a benchmark to evaluate the global progress toward climate mitigation and helps identify areas of improvement.
 
• It fosters international cooperation by sharing best practices and promoting accountability among nations.
